name: What are the signs that I need a new hot water heater?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that I need a new hot water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common indicators that your hot water heater may need replacement include a lack of hot water, rust-colored water, metallic odors, strange noises like rumbling or popping from the tank, and visible leaks around the unit. An increase in your energy bills without a change in usage can also suggest your water heater is becoming inefficient. If your unit is over 10-12 years old, it's generally a good idea to consider replacement even without immediate issues, as older heaters are prone to failure and less energy-efficient.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include lack of hot water, rusty water, noises, leaks, increased energy bills, or if your unit is over 10-12 years old.
